name: Pigmented Paravenous Retinochoroidal Atrophy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Pigmented Paravenous Retinochoroidal Atrophy

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic pigmented deposits along retinal veins
Paravenous areas of retinochoroidal atrophy observed on fundus examination
Supporting imaging findings on fluorescein angiography and optical coherence tomography consistent with paravenous atrophy
Exclusion of other causes of retinochoroidal atrophy such as inflammatory or infectious etiologies

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic pigmented paravenous deposits and paravenous retinochoroidal atrophy on fundus examination with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by multimodal imaging; genetic testing is not routinely diagnostic.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Retinochoroidal atrophy localized along retinal veins
searchTerms: thinning of retina and choroid near veins
retinal and choroidal tissue loss near veins

rare.symptomName: Macular involvement causing central vision loss

searchTerms: new abnormal blood vessels in eye

imaging: Fundus photography showing pigmented paravenous deposits
Fluorescein angiography demonstrating window defects and paravenous atrophy
Optical coherence tomography revealing retinal thinning adjacent to retinal veins
other: Electroretinography may show mild to moderate rod-cone dysfunction

distinguishingFeatures: Diffuse retinal pigmentary changes rather than paravenous distribution
Typical bone-spicule pigmentation not limited to paravenous areas
Often associated with night blindness and progressive vision loss
Inflammatory signs such as vascular sheathing and leakage on angiography
History of systemic inflammatory or infectious disease

redFlags: Macular involvement with central vision impairment
references: Jampol LM, et al. Pigmented paravenous retinochoroidal atrophy: clinical features and differential diagnosis. Ophthalmology. 1984.
Yanagi Y, et al. Multimodal imaging in pigmented paravenous retinochoroidal atrophy. Retina. 2017.
Orphanet: Pigmented paravenous retinochoroidal atrophy. ORPHA:251295.
